title: Project mandate
description: The pre-authorised boundary. Autonomous activity is legitimate only inside it; work that exceeds it returns OUTSIDE_MANDATE and stops rather than manufacturing authority. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'), no trailing newline. Digest is sha256 over those bytes, rendered 'sha256:<hex>'. Two spellings of one object must not produce two digests. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are a minor bump; removing a field, narrowing an enum or making a field required is a MAJOR bump and a new $id.

scope.description: Exclusions are required, not optional. A scope with no stated exclusions cannot answer 'is this outside the mandate?' -- it can only answer 'is this mentioned?'

rollback_owner.description: Named before autonomy begins. Deciding who reverses a change while it is going wrong is the worst possible time to decide it.
